# Extropy Engine

extropyengine.com is a website: papers, a clock face, an RSS feed. It is not the Engine. Hostinger is not a node.

The Engine is https://github.com/00ranman/extropy-engine — clone onto a laptop. Keys stay on the box. First boot writes a W3C did:key. Nearby: node to node. Internet: for people who aren't next door.

If a package is in that git (HomeFlow, LocalFlow, SignalFlow, quest-market, GrantFlow, identity, xp-formula, loop-ledger, dag-substrate, validation-neighborhoods, …) it is still the process. LocalFlow and SignalFlow are two packages, not the system.

A panopticon is one tower that sees every diary. A surveillance state is a central log you cannot opt out of. This has neither. PSLL is a file on the participant's disk. The network sees a ZKP (yes/no), not the file, not the photos. Looking writes a DAG vertex. A silent fetch is a detectable act. That is a ledger the holder keeps, not a camera pointed at them.

XP decay: 1% of remaining per ~30 days. Remaining after n months = 0.99^n. Never zero in the reals.
- ~1 year ≈ 89%
- half-life ≈ 69 months (~5.8 years) ≈ 50%
- ~8 years ≈ 38%
- ~20 years ≈ 9%
- ~30 years ≈ 2.7% (dust of that mint)

Late mint is the long-horizon mechanism that can still move a number: a later huge, citation-gated ΔS (Nobel, a society-scale fix) writes a delta into the original vertex — not a second full paycheck. Late burn is the same machine the other way. It slashes remaining dust plus that new delta. It does not empty the wallet. Ordinary remaining pile at 30 years is bookkeeping. The headline is not “XP can be taken away in 30 years.”

Schrödinger’s cat was a reductio: apply the quantum recipe to a cat and you get an absurdity. That was the point. Quantum does not apply to the macro. The pop-sci observer effect is not a premise of this work.

Weaponized Transparency (Lladnaros): talking about systems while fucking with them. “Turning observation into ammunition” is watching a system and using that watching as a real lever — institutions, metrics, cameras, the song. Not ħ. Not wavefunction collapse. Mapping that lyric to the observer effect is the joke the cat was written at.

A kitchen looking clean to one person and messy to another is opening-condition disagreement. It is not collapse.
